entry.title: Application decided: Markwayne Mullin, Secretary of Homeland Security v. Friends of the Ruidosa Church (No. 26A560) (Granted)
entry.summary: Per curiam. The Government is entitled to a stay of the preliminary injunction halting border-barrier construction because it is exceedingly likely to establish that the District Court lacked jurisdiction under §102(c)(2)(A) of the Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act of 1996 over respondents’ claim that the Secretary of Homeland Security’s waiver of statutory requirements violated the major-questions doctrine.

entry.title: Application decided: Federal Communications Commission v. Sherrod Brown (No. 26A476) (Granted)
entry.summary: Per curiam. The Fourth Circuit’s mandamus order requiring the Federal Communications Commission to resolve an application for review within 48 hours of its entry is stayed because the order improperly interferes with the Commission’s discretion to determine the timing and procedures of its deliberative process.
